```{r,warning = F, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(reactable)
schedule <- read.csv("docs/adit/0_schedule.csv")
tbl <- reactable(
  schedule, 
          defaultColDef = colDef(
            align = "left",
            headerStyle = list(background = "#FFDBBB")
          ),
  
  # Define columns
  columns = list(
    Date = colDef("Date", width = 100),
    Event = colDef("Event", width = 150, filterable = TRUE),
    Speaker = colDef("Speaker", width = 150),
    Time = colDef("Time", width = 100),
    Place = colDef("Place")
  ),
  
  # Other table features
  searchable = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  theme = reactableTheme(
    searchInputStyle = list(width = "20%"),
    borderColor = "#813401"
  )
)
tbl
```
